verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service API platform (accounts, cards, payments, KYC, webhooks). It is not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability; the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes are documentation artifacts, not MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
